rootMotion: code-owned: the root joint is never animated and every clip plays in place

authorSelfScore.scorer: author self-score (the authoring agent; not the independent score create-rigged-character-assets requires)
gaps: The tail hangs to a key at z 0.45 m, where the concept's tail curls back up to a key at about 0.54 m; the head sits low on a forward neck rather than the concept's more upright one (both need bone moves: tail.4 and key heads, neck.1, neck.2 and head).
Ruby saturation is still short of the concept: per-pixel median S 0.68 (idle), 0.70 (frozen), 0.72 (glow-close) against the concept's 0.91, although the red area roughly doubled.

Brass now has no set micro-texture at all (one texel per set, so neither AO nor the normal map varies): up close the plates read as clean, slightly plastic polished metal rather than the concept's lightly worn brass.
In the Blender front compare the polished skull mirrors the dark backdrop (head reads near black); the engine head reads lit (V 0.47).

Glow hue is the project's amber (F08C2C): the engine grille and eyes are hue 33 to 42 against the concept's 25, and in the Blender compare the grille, lenses and eyes read peach at the GLOW_STRENGTH 0.7 convention.
At play distance the seam hairline is faint even at the widened core: the diagonal chest seams read as thin brass ribs from the seat and show the dark split only at glow-close.
Legs are still mostly plated cylinders below the forearm and gaskin; paws are simpler than the concept's arched, individually jointed toes, and the far-side legs are not staggered.
In the engine idle frame the chest prow's key-light highlight lifts the chest brass to V 0.61 (concept 0.45 to 0.53).
authorSelfScore.method: Author self-score on the reviewer's rubric: silhouette and proportions 24/30, signature features 23/25, surface detail and material read 15/20, colour and value 13/15, readability at play distance 9/10. Judged from spring-hound.fidelity-compare.jpg (orthographic EEVEE renders of the low-poly model at the concept's side, front and back angles, framed at the concept's own metres per pixel: side 1.2 m / 855 px, front and back 1.21 m / 875 px) side by side, and from the six in-engine shots in staging/engine (shared brass sets with the manifest tint, hound-glow through the runtime D11 glow; glow-close is idle through a 30 degree lens aimed at the upper body). Widths are background-difference masks in the compare's front panels (1.845 mm per panel px, the reviewer's rows reproduced on the previous compare as 234 against 213 and 206 against 179). Changes since the independent 79 (pass 3): head-on the shoulders are 214 px against the concept's 214 at the reviewer's row 1270 (was 234) and 178 against 180 at row 1220 (was 206); by height band the model front is 0.395 m against 0.395 at z 0.69 to 0.71 (was 0.432), and the head now tapers from the brow down like the concept: 0.177 against 0.188 at z 1.08 to 1.11 (was 0.155), 0.170 against 0.177, 0.157 against 0.162 and 0.151 against 0.151 at the neck coil (was 0.168). The muzzle is a flat-topped wedge. The jaw is rotated 3.5 degrees closed and idle opens it only 0.5 to 2 degrees: the gap under the muzzle is 2.2 to 4.9 mm at rest and 4.5 to 9.3 mm through idle (head frame, y 0.80; was 25 to 38), and the upper teeth hang outside the jaw sides along the lip line, at least 3.0 mm clear of the jaw in every clip. The topline rises over the loin, the rump cowl ends at z 0.69 with a curved back edge, and the keel is a short blunt blade ending at y 0.045 (was a needle). The winding key is a solid flat plate with two 14 mm holes on a 26 mm barrel (bow centroid 0.2 mm off the spin axis). Rubies are taller 56 mm cabochons and the shoulder pair is turned 20 degrees toward the seat on a 30 mm socket: with the reviewer's mask (hue over 320 or under 5, S over 0.35, V over 0.12, whole frame) the idle red area is 190 px against 90 on the previous build (frozen 160 against 66, glow-close 586 against 241), per-pixel median S 0.68 idle, 0.70 frozen, 0.72 glow-close (was 0.59 to 0.61). Seams are a bevelled aged-brass rib split by a gunmetal hairline about 2 mm wide where it clears the bead. The glow-close wood grain and rope striations came from the sets' ORM red (AO) channel tiling every 0.5 m, not the normal map (a normalScale 0 build kept them unchanged); every brass face now samples one AO-255 texel of its set, with the slot tint scaled by 0.87 for the lost AO mean, and the grain is gone (engine idle head V 0.47, chest V 0.61, within 0.02 of the tiled build). The compare lighting is the fixed warden-matched rig and was not tuned to the score.

independentScore.scorer: independent reviewer agent (separate from the authoring agent; did not build the asset)

rubric.note: Up 2 from 21. The front shoulder width is fixed. In the fidelity compare front panels (background-difference mask, rows every 10 px) the model is 200 px against the concept's 202 at y 1270 and 213 against 214 at y 1290, where pass 2 measured 233 against 212. The upper chest is now slightly narrow: 153 against 172 at y 1220. The side silhouette bounding box is 797x588 against 815x596 (within 2.5 percent), and the head top sits at y 22 against 23, so the head is no longer carried low. The jaw-closed claim holds in side view. In 6x crops of the compare, (1660,340)-(1780,410) against (740,340)-(860,410), the model mouth slit is about 8 to 10 px against the concept's 12 to 16 px. Still off: (1) Head-on, which is the seat view, the head is a domed cranium over a round tube muzzle, not the concept's flat-topped tapering wedge. It is 87 to 91 px wide at jaw level (y 1140-1150) against 80 to 82, and glow-close (crop (300,180)-(480,370)) still shows a row of four or five fangs over a separate jaw bar. (2) The head is about 11 percent longer: the occiput sits about 25 px further back with the same nose x (843 against 844). (3) The rump is a box with a square rear corner: the top edge 125 px in from the rear is at y 203 against the concept's 302. (4) The keel spike remains. (5) The front paws stand 157 to 158 px apart against 201 to 203 at y 1610-1620 (22 percent narrower), a fault pass 2 did not record. (6) The ears are round caps rather than folded-back flaps, and the hind paws are flat sleds.

Unchanged at 22. The improvement and the new deduction offset each other. Improved: rubies are 2.5 times larger in engine, 176 red px in idle.jpg against 69 at pass 2 (mask hue over 320 or under 5, S over 0.35). Eyes stay right: idle eye glow 211 px against grille 491 px (S over 0.4, V over 0.8), ratio 0.43 against the concept's 0.41. Coil spine, neck coils, hinged jaw and joint rubies are present. Deductions: (1) The winding key is unchanged since pass 2. In the side compare hind crop (20,380)-(360,900) against (935,380)-(1275,900) it is still two wire rings on a rod, not a solid flat bow plate with two small holes. (2) The tail root now rises above the rump before hanging straight down to the key, where the concept's tail sweeps down and back from the rump. (3) Newly charged, not newly broken: the chest core is a wide, low slot. Engine grille glow bounding box w/h is 1.64 in glow-close ((355,524)-(423,565)) and 1.57 in idle, against 1.01 for the concept's round core ((1661,434)-(1736,508)). It sits at about 80 percent of chest height in idle (y 370-392 on a chest spanning about y 305-400), against about 55 percent in the concept.

Up 1 from 14. Pass-3 claim verified on the chest: at glow-close the chest plate (365,425)-(440,480) shows only broad reflection bands and no wood-grain striation (nearest-neighbour 4x crop (340,410)-(520,520)). High-pass std (luma minus a 3 px Gaussian blur) is 9.6 there, and that includes the seam ribs. The rope look is not gone across the model, though. The spine coils at glow-close (440,300)-(600,420) still read as combed, striated strands with no dark gaps between rings, high-pass std 14.8, about 1.5 times the chest. The centre-seam claim is partial. The line is a short raised brass rib with a dark hairline beside it, about 52 px long against a chest plate about 105 px tall (y 450-502 of 415-520), so it reads as a decorative dash rather than a split between two plates. The diagonal seams are the same thin ribs, not the concept's bevelled, layered plate edges. Plates now read clean and slightly plastic, with no light wear. Legs below the forearm and gaskin are plain cylinders, and the paws are simpler than the concept's jointed toes.

Unchanged at 13. sRGB medians use a warm-metal mask (max channel over 35, R over B plus 12, glow excluded). The engine idle head (395,185)-(450,240) is (120,88,57), hue 29.3, V 0.47, against the concept side head (1030,70)-(1310,230) at (116,81,55), hue 25.6, V 0.45, which is close. The idle chest (395,305)-(485,360) is (138,100,64), V 0.54, and the glow-close chest is V 0.58, lighter than the concept's 0.45 but inside the art bible's polished-brass intent (#DEC16A). Brass is still about 4 degrees yellower. Glow matches: idle grille median (243,186,75) and eyes (241,171,65) against the concept grille hue 37. The rubies improved but are still short: per-pixel median S is 0.68 idle, 0.72 glow-close, 0.70 attack, 0.67 hit and 0.69 frozen (pass 2: 0.60 to 0.66), against 0.93 for the concept ruby (median (84,5,27)). At glow-close the neck and spine coils read paler and less saturated than the plates.

Unchanged at 9. At 2.6 m in idle.jpg the face and core read: 591 glow px in total (S over 0.6, V over 0.85), of which the eyes are 182 and the grille 409. The rubies now show as distinct crimson dots (176 px), where pass 2 found a few dark pixels. hit.jpg and attack.jpg stay readable. The body separates from the floor through highlights and dark joint bands, not through its median (chest V 0.54 against floor V 0.55). Deduction: head-on, the long tube muzzle and the fang row still make the head read as a generic or rodent snout before it reads as a greyhound. Not charged, noted only: death.jpg is a rigid sideways topple with straight legs where the concept's death is curled up, and frozen.jpg shows no tint shift (a roster-wide runtime ice tint, not the hound's).

topFixes: Rebuild the head-on read, which is the seat view: flatten the domed cranium and turn the round tube muzzle into a flat-topped wedge tapering to the nose, narrow the jaw-level width about 10 percent (91 px down to the concept's 82 at y 1145 of the compare front), shorten the head about 10 percent by bringing the occiput forward, and tuck the fangs inside the lip line so no row of teeth shows head-on at rest.

Reshape the chest core into the concept's centred, near-round vertical cage: glow bounding box w/h near 1.0 (now 1.57 to 1.64), centred at about 55 percent of chest height (now about 80 percent, a low slot under the chest bulb).

Fix the tail and key: start the tail at the back of the rump instead of rising above it, sweep it down and back in an arc, and replace the two-wire-ring key with a solid flat bow plate with two small holes.

Correct the remaining body silhouette: round off the rump's square rear corner (top edge at y 203 against the concept's 302, 125 px in from the rear of the side compare), cut back the keel spike, splay the front paws to the concept stance (157 px apart against 203 at y 1615 of the compare front), and fold the ears back as flaps rather than round caps.

Clean up the spine coils at close range: remove the striated normal so each ring reads as a separate rounded coil with a dark gap (high-pass std 14.8 against the chest's 9.6 at glow-close), and extend the centre chest seam to a full-height plate split with bevelled edges.
Push ruby saturation from a per-pixel median S of about 0.70 toward the concept's 0.93 in engine, with a darker, more saturated base colour or a small emissive term.
independentScore.method: Independent pass-3 re-score using the same five-criterion rubric, re-checking each pass-2 deduction from the independentScore object in provenance.json and testing the three pass-3 claims. The author self-score and the gap list printed at the top of the fidelity-compare and review-sheet images were ignored, and no number here comes from them; authorSelfScore and staging/fidelity.json were not read. Shape: the fidelity compare (orthographic side, front and back at the concept's metres per pixel) was measured with Pillow and numpy. Side silhouette bounding boxes and top and bottom profiles every 25 px came from a background-difference mask (RGB distance over 45 from the panel-edge median). Front silhouette widths every 10 px came from the same mask (threshold 40) over concept front x 12-308 and model front x 322-618, y 990-1695. Six-times crops checked the jaw gap, and paired side-by-side crops covered the hindquarters, tail, key and forequarters. Material and colour were weighted on the six engine shots (three.js runtime, seat camera). Measures used: warm-metal sRGB medians with HSV, glow as HSV S over 0.6 and V over 0.85, eye-to-grille ratios with S over 0.4 and V over 0.8, ruby mask hue over 320 or under 5 with S over 0.35, grille shape from the glow bounding box, and surface striation as the std of luma minus a 3 px Gaussian blur, with gradient magnitudes. Concept boxes are in full-resolution 2752x1536 pixels. The review sheet and Blender renders were viewed as a secondary check on stance and the animation poses. The art bible palette (#DEC16A brass, #F3BE65 amber, #93212B ruby) was the material reference. The rise from 79 comes from the front-width fix, the closed jaw in side view, the removal of chest grain and the larger rubies. The head-on muzzle, the key, the tail, the chest-core shape and the striated coils hold it to 82.
